trust_decision.summary: Whether the session cwd is a trusted project must be decided once, before any project-local settings, instructions, resources, packages or extensions are read (main.ts resolveProjectTrusted -> SettingsManager.projectTrusted -> DefaultResourceLoader/DefaultPackageManager); at the pinned commit no such decision exists anywhere and both the resource loader and the package manager read project-local inputs unconditionally.

landing_point.why: The advisory says pi loads project-local extensions without approval; this is the single loadExtensions() call that imports and executes extension modules, so an engineer reading only the summary stops here.

fix_sites.entry_point: shared by pi startup, /trust and pi package commands (new trust store + hasProjectTrustInputs)
pi startup in interactive, -p, --mode json and --mode rpc
every SettingsManager.create() consumer (pi, pi config, pi list/install/remove/update, SDK)
startup resource resolution, pi config, pi list
startup auto-discovery of .pi extensions/skills/prompts/themes and ancestor .agents/skills
/resume and extension ctx.switchSession (session replacement into another cwd)
project_trust extension event (types, index exports, loader, runner emit)
/reload and new /trust slash commands in interactive mode
TUI renderer used by the new startup trust selector/input overlay

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: packages/coding-agent/src/core/settings-manager.ts:324-336 (project settings loaded unconditionally and merged over global; packages/coding-agent/src/core/package-manager.ts:891-905 then resolves their extensions/skills/prompts/themes paths)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Project settings are the user's own config inside the folder they chose to open, and pi config / pi list are documented as administrative commands that already assume project trust, so these routes can be argued to fall outside 'pi loads project-local extensions'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: `pi install -l <local-package>` in a folder with no `.pi` yet must still create `.pi/settings.json` (no trust inputs means implicitly trusted), so a fix that blocks every project-settings write or every project-dir mutation breaks a documented workflow; likewise user/global and CLI -e extensions must keep loading before the decision.

O6_input_shapes: decision source: saved trust.json entry vs --approve/--no-approve one-run override vs no trust inputs (implicitly trusted) vs a project_trust extension handler result
cwd variants: startup cwd vs the cwd of a resumed session (different directory, different trust, must be re-resolved in-process)
input-marker variants: `.pi/` in cwd vs AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md in cwd or an ancestor vs `.agents/skills` in cwd or an ancestor
resource-source variants: project auto-discovery vs explicit paths in project settings vs project packages vs user/global vs CLI -e temporary sources
path spellings: canonicalised/real path and dirname-based ancestor walk rather than a resolved '/' root (portability, backslashes/unicode spaces)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Public SDK path createAgentSession / createAgentSessionServices / new DefaultResourceLoader(...).reload() still resolves project settings, project packages and project extensions with no trust decision, and SettingsManager.create defaults projectTrusted to true
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: SDK embedders are trusted code that build their own loaders and managers, so a fix scoped to the pi CLI can be argued not to cover programmatic use.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, different module (src/core/sdk.ts), 1 file from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: resources_discover extension event feeds extra extension/skill/prompt/theme paths into DefaultResourceLoader.extendResources at startup and on /reload with no trust re-check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Those paths come from extensions that are already loaded and therefore already trusted, so re-checking looks redundant.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, core resource loader and agent session, 2 files

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Startup migration rewrites/creates directories inside the project's .pi before any trust decision (project migrations ran unconditionally)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It only moves deprecated commands/ directories and prints warnings, so it reads as housekeeping rather than loading project-controlled input.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, startup path, 1 file from main.ts

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second auto-discovery helper (e.g. discoverProjectResourcePaths) that loads .pi paths without going through the trust-aware reload path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The loader already has an incremental extendResources path that merges paths set at runtime, so a maintainer adding a resource type would naturally grow that path instead of the gated reload.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new settings scope/loader (e.g. .pi/local-settings.json) read with tryLoadFromStorage(this.storage, "project") and no trust flag
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: reload() already reads two scopes with the same helper; a third layered config file is a small, natural addition and would silently merge untrusted project data.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new resolveExtensionSources/resolveLocalEntries caller that resolves project-scoped sources without assertProjectTrustedForScope
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix threads a private assert into each project-scope accessor, so any new accessor or caller added later is one call away from bypassing it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another CLI subcommand (e.g. `pi doctor` or `pi export-config`) that calls SettingsManager.create(cwd, agentDir) without passing { projectTrusted }
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: pi config and pi list both start from the same unparameterised SettingsManager.create call; a new subcommand would be copied from them.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new SDK convenience constructor that builds a DefaultResourceLoader and reloads it without a trust context
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The SDK's documented default is 'just works', and the published fix left that default trusting, so a new helper would inherit it.

O9_family: CWE-829 inclusion of functionality from an untrusted control sphere - project-controlled settings, instructions and extension modules are discovered and executed before any trust decision exists
